title: Cryptopia
tagline: A professional social platform for web3. Only verified project owner can post so less spams here.
description:
Cryptopia is a cross-chain web3 social platform. Only verified project owner can post here, so there are less spams. Users can only comment or participate in an event or airdrop. Project owners can post announcements, airdrops, events and jobs. Users can follow the projects they are interested in. 

Users can also join project's own group chat, but they have to hold that project's tokens to be able to enter or talk.
